about.en: AIW3 is an AI-agent platform for Web3 that combines on-chain analytics, wallet and market research and automated strategy execution. The AIW3 token, with a 1,000,000,000 supply, is a BNB Chain token at 0x37E94fc028903E74275478b65160D6d2c0e8880b and is also issued as a Hyperliquid spot token linked to HyperEVM contract 0x7b3125f8fba8e1b84a069becd7caaf5289438da7.
